units.source_text: 且说那位尚侍胧月夜最近回娘家右大臣邸来了。

en.t: Now Lady Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami, had recently returned to her family home at the Minister of the Right's residence.

units.source_text: 因为她久病疟疾，回娘家来，念咒祈祷等事较宫中方便。

en.t: Because she had long been ill with malaria, it was more convenient at her family home than in the palace to arrange incantations, prayers, and similar rites.

units.source_text: 做了种种法事之后，病体痊愈，大家十分庆喜。

en.t: After many religious services had been performed, her illness passed, and everyone was greatly delighted.

units.source_text: 尚侍认为此乃难得的良机，便与源氏大将密约，用尽心计，图得夜夜幽会。

en.t: The Naishi no Kami saw this as a rare opportunity, made secret arrangements with General Genji, and used every device she could to meet him privately night after night.

units.source_text: 这尚侍正当青春年华，花容月貌，妩媚动人。

en.t: This lady was in the full bloom of youth, with a flower-like face and moon-like beauty, charming and deeply alluring.

units.source_text: 近来因病略微消瘦，却反而更可怜爱。

en.t: Lately she had grown a little thin from illness, but that only made her seem all the more tender and lovable.

units.source_text: 此时她的大姐弘徽殿太后也回娘家来，一同住在邸内。

en.t: At this time her elder sister, the Kokiden Empress Dowager, had also returned to the family home and was staying in the same residence.

units.source_text: 四周人目众多，行动颇多危险。

en.t: There were many watchful eyes all around, so any movement involved considerable danger.

units.source_text: 然而源氏大将一向有个习癖：越是困难，越是不舍。

en.t: Yet General Genji had always had one peculiar habit: the more difficult something was, the less willing he was to give it up.

units.source_text: 因此夜夜偷渡，几无虚夕。

en.t: And so he slipped across to her night after night, scarcely letting an evening pass in vain.
Naturally, it was impossible to keep this from being noticed.

units.source_text: 然而众人都有顾虑，所以无人将此事启奏太后。

en.t: But everyone had their own reservations, so no one reported the matter to the Empress Dowager.
The Minister of the Right, of course, never imagined it.
